questions.prompt: One of these enzymes is a real biochemical speedster, capable of slashing a reaction time from 78 million years down to just 18 milliseconds. Which one deserves the trophy for the most extreme catalysis in nature?
questions.hint: The real enzyme's name refers to a specific nucleotide modification process, not a made-up 'speed' or 'time' themed term.
questions.explanation: Orotidine 5′-phosphate decarboxylase is an enzyme involved in pyrimidine biosynthesis that holds the record for the greatest rate enhancement known in enzymatic catalysis.

questions.prompt:
Which Wikipedia article are we describing? Bonus points if you already know the creators behind Hong Kong 97 apparently couldn't resist a follow-up act.
A strategy game created by the same people responsible for Hong Kong 97 where you play as Shoko Asahara and the end goal is to carry out the Tokyo subway sarin gas attack. Often mistakenly believed to have been created by Asahara's cult themselves as propaganda.
questions.hint: The real title references a specific village in Japan, not a date, subway system, or the cult's name directly.

questions.prompt: Sikh underwear made history in more ways than one: In what year did Guru Gobind Singh institute the Kachera as one of the Five Ks upon founding the Khalsa?
questions.explanation: The article states that the Kachera became mandatory for baptized Sikhs in 1699, when Guru Gobind Singh established the Khalsa and instituted the Five Ks.

questions.prompt: U Thant Island is a tiny landmass in New York's East River—just 2,000 square feet, yet packed with surprisingly deep history. What was this artificial island originally created from?
choices: Rock excavated during subway tunnel construction
Debris from the construction of the Brooklyn Bridge
Landfill from the construction of the United Nations headquarters
questions.hint: The island's formation is tied to underground infrastructure work in NYC, not to bridges or ships—think of what needs to be dug out to build something below the surface.
questions.explanation: U Thant Island was formed from rock excavated during the construction of a subway tunnel, and later became known for its connection to the UN and its use as a bird sanctuary.

questions.prompt:
Forget cockfighting with roosters — some flatworms take the phrase quite literally. Which article describes this fittingly named practice?
A literal, figurative variety of cockfighting between some species of flatworm, in which two hermaphroditic worms duel with their penises to determine who will play the role of male inseminator rather than the more costly female egg-bearer.
questions.hint: The correct term directly names the body part involved and uses a sporting metaphor for combat — think swords, not stingers or wounds.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Penis fencing,' a mating behavior observed in some flatworm species where two hermaphroditic individuals joust with their penises to avoid being the one that must bear the resulting eggs.

article.title: George H. W. Bush vomiting incident
